name: ze_Pt6_TON
title: Pt6 @ TON
description: Pt6 cluster in the one-dimensional 10-ring channel (4.6 x 5.7 A) of a frozen all-silica TON (ZSM-22/Theta-1) framework (NEP89-relaxed from a symmetry-broken start, 1x1x3 supercell, 216 atoms; density within 0.3 % of Theta-1); Pt/ZSM-22 is the classic shape-selective n-alkane hydroisomerisation catalyst (Martens and co-workers). Framework Al/H+ sites and framework relaxation are absent, NEP89 binds Pt to siloxane O (Pt-O ~2.2 A) and places this framework 3.6 kJ/mol SiO2 below alpha-quartz, so the global minimum is a model-PES optimum (Pt is used because NEP89 spuriously embeds Ir/Rh atoms into silica walls).
